title: Data Retrieval & Evaluation
summary: This module provides comprehensive tools for managing datasets, integrating various retrieval systems to fetch relevant information, and offering a suite of metrics for evaluating DSPy program performance. It streamlines data handling and assessment for building robust LLM applications.

nodes.label: Manage DSPy Datasets
nodes.title: DSPy Datasets Module
nodes.description: Handles loading, splitting, and managing datasets for training and evaluation, including specialized datasets like AlfWorld, GSM8K, and MATH.

nodes.label: Integrate Retrieval Systems
nodes.title: DSPy Retrieval Modules
nodes.description: Connects DSPy programs to various external knowledge bases and vector databases (e.g., ColBERTv2, Databricks, Weaviate) to fetch relevant information.

nodes.label: Evaluate Program Performance
nodes.title: Evaluation Metrics & Auto-Evaluation
nodes.description: Offers a comprehensive suite of metrics, including LLM-based auto-evaluation for semantic F1, completeness, and groundedness, to assess DSPy program quality.

nodes.label: Provide Core DSP Utilities
nodes.title: DSP Utilities
nodes.description: Contains essential utility functions for text tokenization, answer location, robust configuration management, and batch data loading, supporting other modules.

nodes.label: DSPy Program
nodes.title: DSPy Program Module
nodes.description: The main DSPy program or module that utilizes data, retrieval, and evaluation components to perform its task.

nodes.label: External Data Sources
nodes.title: External Data Sources
nodes.description: Various external sources like Hugging Face datasets, vector databases, or local files that provide raw data or knowledge bases.

nodes.label: Language Model
nodes.title: Language Model Client
nodes.description: The underlying language model used by DSPy programs for generation, and potentially by retrievers for embedding queries or passages.

groups.label: Core Functional Modules
groups.title: Core Functional Modules
groups.description: The primary sub-modules within 'Data Retrieval & Evaluation' that provide distinct functionalities for data management, information retrieval, and performance assessment.

groups.label: DSPy Program Interaction
groups.title: DSPy Program Interaction
groups.description: Represents how DSPy programs and underlying language models interact with the data retrieval and evaluation components.

groups.label: External Data Providers
groups.title: External Data Providers
groups.description: Illustrates the external sources from which data is ingested by the datasets and retrieval modules.
